description: a refresh token already consumed by a prior rotation is single-use and returns 401 revoked_token on reuse (R10)
a refresh token explicitly invalidated via /revoke returns 401 revoked_token, and it fails immediately rather than at its natural expiry (R11, R14)
a syntactically invalid/garbage refresh token returns 401 invalid_token (R12)
an access token submitted where a refresh token is expected returns 401 wrong_type rather than being treated as merely unrecognized (R13)
